title: Source connectivity approvals late
description_cause_event_effect: On-prem network changes need CAB (3-4 wks) -> SHIR firewall rules + private endpoints late -> no source connectivity for build
mitigation_actions: Raise NET tickets in week 1; build against synthetic data; weekly chase with network lead
contingency_plan: Extract via DBA-provided files for SIT if still blocked by 2026-08-01

title: CDC cannot be enabled on MES prod
description_cause_event_effect: SQL Agent/CDC needs sysadmin + change window -> CDC not enabled in time -> no deletes, full loads only
mitigation_actions: CDC in ICD (doc 03); prove on MES QA; book prod window
contingency_plan: Watermark on modified_at + weekly full compare
trigger_early_warning: MES QA enablement not done by 2026-07-15

title: CDC retention shorter than an outage (LSN gap)
description_cause_event_effect: Retention 3 days -> outage > 3 days (e.g. holiday weekend) -> changes purged before extraction -> silent loss of updates/deletes
mitigation_actions: Retention 7 days; LSN-gap check throws; SHIR offline alert; runbook procedure

title: Oracle watermark misses deletes / untriggered updates
description_cause_event_effect: LAST_UPDATE_DATE watermark -> hard deletes or updates that bypass the trigger are invisible -> gold differs from ERP
mitigation_actions: ICD: soft deletes only; weekly key compare job; reconciliation to ERP totals in SIT
contingency_plan: Weekly full load of affected table
trigger_early_warning: Any SIT reconciliation variance vs ERP

title: KPI definitions disputed
description_cause_event_effect: Plants and finance define OEE / production day differently -> no agreed definition -> rework, no UAT sign-off
mitigation_actions: KPI glossary workshop; VP Ops sign-off before build (DEC-03)

title: Source data quality worse than assumed
description_cause_event_effect: Profiling shows invalid rows -> high quarantine volumes -> incomplete KPIs
mitigation_actions: Profiling; quarantine + stewards; source fixes via MES vendor

title: Key-person dependency
description_cause_event_effect: One engineer holds ADF framework + MES schema knowledge -> absence stops ingestion work
mitigation_actions: Pairing rota; LLDs; recorded walkthroughs
trigger_early_warning: Single reviewer on > 50% of ingestion PRs

title: Scope creep
description_cause_event_effect: Requests for recipes / process parameters / ML -> unplanned work -> build overrun
mitigation_actions: Change request process (doc 12); phase-2 backlog; product owner prioritisation

title: Snowflake credit overrun
description_cause_event_effect: DirectQuery on large facts -> query per visual -> credits exceed budget
mitigation_actions: DirectQuery only on small views; resource monitor 80/100%; Import model
contingency_plan: Suspend DQ pages; switch to Import

title: Backfill skew exceeds window
description_cause_event_effect: ~40 machine keys + 10x readings on presses -> straggler tasks in sensor x run join -> 1-year backfill overruns weekend window
mitigation_actions: Salting in backfill mode; date partitions; dedicated backfill cluster
contingency_plan: Backfill in monthly slices over 2 weekends

title: CMMS API limits / unannounced changes
description_cause_event_effect: Vendor rate limits or changes response -> extraction fails or misses fields
mitigation_actions: Retries + throttling; contract test vs sandbox; notice period in ICD
contingency_plan: Manual CSV export from CMMS for affected days

title: Personal data in MES free text
description_cause_event_effect: Operators type names into comment fields -> personal data lands in lake -> GDPR exposure
mitigation_actions: Exclude free-text columns; pseudonymous ids only; InfoSec review
trigger_early_warning: Column added to extraction without review

title: Pen test / InfoSec sign-off late
description_cause_event_effect: Pen-test slots scarce in Q4 -> no sign-off -> go-live blocked
mitigation_actions: Security design approved early; slot requested 2026-08-25; escalated to CISO office 2026-09-29
contingency_plan: Go-live with read-only scope + pen test in hypercare (needs CISO waiver)

title: Snowflake network policy needs NAT IPs
description_cause_event_effect: Platform team backlog -> NAT egress IPs not provided -> publish to Snowflake blocked in test
mitigation_actions: NET-231 escalated; validate publish in dev

title: Test data not production-like
description_cause_event_effect: Test env holds weeks not years of data -> performance issues only visible in UAT/prod
mitigation_actions: Synthetic generator at 1-year scale; masked prod copy request (SEC approval)
contingency_plan: Extend SIT by 1 week for perf fixes

title: UAT testers unavailable
description_cause_event_effect: Quarter/month-end in Nov-Dec -> business testers unavailable -> UAT slips -> go-live slips
mitigation_actions: UAT booked 11-16 to 12-04 avoiding month-end week; 6 named testers requested (A-04)

title: Users distrust new KPIs vs legacy Excel
description_cause_event_effect: Legacy Excel uses different rules -> numbers differ -> users reject platform
mitigation_actions: 2-week parallel run; variance explanation log; published definitions; plant champions
trigger_early_warning: Unexplained variance > 1% on any plant KPI

title: Support not ready at hypercare exit
description_cause_event_effect: KT incomplete -> L2 cannot run reruns / resets -> dev team stuck on support
mitigation_actions: KT plan + reverse KT + runbook (doc 13)

title: Runtime/library deprecation
description_cause_event_effect: DBR / connector versions deprecated during project -> forced upgrade + retest
mitigation_actions: LTS runtime 15.4; Dependabot; quarterly review

title: Power BI capacity contention
description_cause_event_effect: Shared capacity busy at 06:00 -> refresh throttled -> slow / late reports
mitigation_actions: Event-driven refresh; incremental refresh; Capacity Metrics monitoring
trigger_early_warning: Refresh duration > 30 min twice in a week
